audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says diff HARD but carries the favoured tone colour, a 4/10 difficulty rating and a 'Favoured matchup' final line — four fields giving three different answers.
audit.why: 50.7% over 142 games with a chart Kled owns from level 2 to first item is an even lane, not a favoured one and not a hard one. The content layer already calls the late 'genuinely a coin flip'.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone #e8b84b, diffRating 6/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t reworded to match. Carry threat 6/10 is correct and unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Quinn levels 2, 3, 6 and two items despite whys[1..6] describing Kled flipping every one of those stages with the Bear Trap pull, remount autos and Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.
audit.why: Packet chart is Quinn, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill, and the audited mirror moved rows 1-6 as one group with row 0 left to Quinn. Level 1 is genuinely Quinn's — dismounted Kled has no Skaarl.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Kled and row 6 to Skill, in matched full/content pairs; row 0 stays Quinn. Spike ladder (lvl 1 dismount window, lvl 2-3 pull-and-remount, lvl 6 R, 2+ items outscale) is accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is named but its mechanic — four massive-attack-speed autos on a 13s cooldown, opened by an auto reset — never reaches the page, and no Kled cooldown is given anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: W is flagged autoReset, 13/12/11/10/9s, 'massive attack speed for four attacks, fourth deals more damage'. Q is 11/10/9/8/7s, E is a 13s recastable double dash, R is 140s. The auto-reset tell is the listed missing interaction.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d now carry the real numbers, the wind-up tell, and what Vault actually does (dash to him, leap off to max attack range).

audit.why: Bear Trap 11s at rank 1; Jousting 13s; Violent Tendencies 13s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the cooldown block, the do's and report[5].

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kled carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Kled carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Bear Trap on a Rope and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you dodge Bear Trap on a Rope and how disciplined your kiting is.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Vault/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1 down to 7s — his engage hook, so dodge it and punish the miss. - Violent Tendencies: 13s, four massive-speed attacks. - Jousting: a 13s double dash.

edits.before: His engage hook. Vault/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage hook on 11s at rank 1 — dodge it, then punish the miss.

edits.before: Kled wastes Bear Trap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vault to him and leap off: you land at max attack range, out of reach.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. Vault/dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 — dodge it. Violent Tendencies gives four fast autos: step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Skaarl returns on courage he builds by hitting you — deny it.

notes: Packet header disagrees with itself on volume: games 148 at the top, games 142 inside the packet. Not blocking (both well above zero) but worth a look at the packet builder. Per the mirror, no cooldown was written for Quinn's R — the kit's '3' is the flight/recast timer, not the ability cooldown. 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' style wording still sits inside breakdown.trading and report[3].t here as it did on the mirror; left alone rather than rewriting otherwise-sound trade advice.
